## portcheck browser uninstall

Remove portcheck's browser registration

```
portcheck browser uninstall [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --browser strings   browsers to unregister from (default: all)
  -h, --help              help for uninstall
```

      --json                shorthand for --output json

  -v, --verbose             log diagnostic details to stderr
